mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen 11.9 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w, indicating an ongoing recovery trend. This upward momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC higher than the baseline mean of the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -37.3 to -25.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has improved by 6.6 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w. When transit accessibility increases, commuters and shoppers gain mobility to reach retail destinations, directly lifting RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise in the week following a TRANSIT improvement of >5 percentage points in more than two consecutive instances.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has declined from -37.9 to -31.6 percentage points, but remains severely depressed. If WORKPLACES continues to recover and TRANSIT simultaneously improves, the combined effect of restored commuting and transit access will amplify RETAIL_REC recovery over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve by >3 percentage points in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean when both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve simultaneously by >3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has shifted from -2.6 to +2.1 percentage points, crossing into positive territory. This signals restored confidence in essential shopping and public mobility. Consumers emboldened by essential-goods recovery will increase discretionary retail visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses from negative to positive
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM crossed zero between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week immediately following GROCERY_PHARM's transition to positive values.

candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 30 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks of a PARKS decline exceeding 30 percentage points.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 15 percentage points while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL falls below 15 and both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve simultaneously.
